def.micro: one of four parts of a year
def.short: one of the four parts of the year: spring, summer, autumn or winter
def.long: One of the four parts of the year: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Each one has its own weather. Some hot countries have only a rainy season and a dry season.

examples.en: Spring is the best season in Istanbul.
examples.tr: İstanbul'da en güzel mevsim ilkbahardır.

examples.en: Which season do you like best, Elif?
examples.tr: En çok hangi mevsimi seviyorsun, Elif?

examples.en: In Thailand, the rainy season starts in May.
examples.tr: Tayland'da yağmur mevsimi mayısta başlar.

etymology.text: From Old French 'seson', from Latin 'satio', meaning sowing: at first it meant the time of year for planting seeds.

tr.note: 'Season' sezon anlamına da gelir: turizm sezonu (tourist season), bir dizinin yeni sezonu (a new season). Bu kartta mevsim anlamı var.

quiz.cloze: There are four ______ in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

def.short: plants, animals, rivers, mountains and everything else that people did not make
def.long: All the plants, animals, mountains, rivers and seas in the world, and not the things that people make. Many people like to spend their free time in nature.

examples.en: We spent the weekend out in nature, far from the city.
examples.tr: Hafta sonunu şehirden uzakta, doğada geçirdik.

examples.en: Deniz loves taking photos of nature.
examples.tr: Deniz doğa fotoğrafları çekmeyi çok sever.

examples.en: Walking in nature helps Ana relax after a long week.
examples.tr: Doğada yürümek, uzun bir haftanın ardından Ana'nın rahatlamasına yardımcı olur.

etymology.text: From Latin 'natura', which comes from 'nasci', meaning to be born.

tr.note: 'Nature' bir kişinin huyu, yaradılışı anlamına da gelir: 'She is kind by nature.' (Yaradılıştan nazik biridir.)

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'doğayı seviyorum' derken belirtme eki var, bu da 'the' eklemeye iter. Genel anlamda doğadan söz ederken 'nature' önüne 'the' gelmez.

quiz.cloze: Ece loves ______: trees, birds, rivers and mountains.

def.micro: go outside on foot for fun
def.short: leave the house and move on foot for pleasure or exercise
def.long: To leave home and move on foot for a short time, for fun or exercise. People often do it after dinner, in a park or by the sea.

grammar.pattern: go for a walk (in the park / by the sea)

examples.en: Let's go for a walk after dinner.
examples.tr: Akşam yemeğinden sonra yürüyüşe çıkalım.

examples.en: Every morning, Murat goes for a walk with his dog.
examples.tr: Murat her sabah köpeğiyle yürüyüşe çıkar.

examples.en: The rain stopped, so we went for a walk by the lake.
examples.tr: Yağmur durdu, biz de göl kenarında yürüyüşe çıktık.

collocations: go for a walk in the park

tr.note: Aynı anlamda 'take a walk' de denir; Amerikan İngilizcesinde daha yaygındır.

mistakes.why: Türkçedeki 'yürüyüş yapmak' kalıbı 'make' kullanmaya iter. İngilizcede 'go for a walk' ya da 'take a walk' denir.

quiz.cloze: We left the car at home and ______ in the park with the dog.

def.short: clean, cool air outside, not the warm old air inside a room
def.long: Clean, cool air outside, not the old air inside a building. People open a window or go outside to get some.

examples.en: Let's open the window and get some fresh air.
examples.tr: Pencereyi açıp biraz temiz hava alalım.

examples.en: After work, Selin goes to the park for some fresh air.
examples.tr: Selin işten sonra biraz temiz hava almak için parka gider.

examples.en: We spent the day by the sea, and the fresh air helped us sleep well.
examples.tr: Günü deniz kenarında geçirdik; temiz hava iyi uyumamıza yardımcı oldu.

tr.note: 'Air' sayılamaz; 'a fresh air' denmez. 'A breath of fresh air' ise mecazen ferahlatıcı, yeni ve güzel bir şey demektir.

mistakes.wrong: I'm going out to take fresh air.
mistakes.right: I'm going out to get some fresh air.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki 'temiz hava almak' kalıbı 'take' kullanmaya iter. İngilizcede 'get some fresh air' denir.

quiz.cloze: I've been inside all day. I need to go out and get some ______.

def.micro: eat a meal outside in nature
def.short: eat a meal outside, for example in a park, with food that you bring
def.long: To take food with you and eat it outside, for example in a park, on a beach or in a forest. People often sit on a blanket on the grass.

grammar.pattern: have a picnic (in the park / by the lake)

examples.en: Let's have a picnic in the park on Sunday.
examples.tr: Pazar günü parkta piknik yapalım.

examples.en: Burak and his friends had a picnic by the lake.
examples.tr: Burak ve arkadaşları göl kenarında piknik yaptı.

examples.en: We wanted to have a picnic, but it started to rain, so we ate in the car.
examples.tr: Piknik yapmak istedik ama yağmur başladı, biz de arabada yedik.

collocations: have a picnic in the park

tr.note: 'Go on a picnic' (pikniğe gitmek) da çok kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: We made a picnic last weekend.
mistakes.right: We had a picnic last weekend.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki 'piknik yapmak' kalıbı 'make' kullanmaya iter. İngilizcede 'have a picnic' denir.

quiz.cloze: The weather is lovely. Let's take some sandwiches and ______ by the river.

def.micro: sleep in a tent for fun
def.short: go away for a holiday and sleep in a tent, usually in nature
def.long: To go away for a short holiday and sleep in a tent, often in a forest, near a lake or in the mountains. You can do it with friends or family.

grammar.pattern: go camping (in the mountains / by a lake)

examples.en: We go camping every summer.
examples.tr: Her yaz kampa gideriz.

examples.en: Last August, Jonas went camping in the mountains with his friends.
examples.tr: Jonas geçen ağustos arkadaşlarıyla dağlara kampa gitti.

examples.en: If it doesn't rain this weekend, Aylin wants to go camping by the sea.
examples.tr: Bu hafta sonu yağmur yağmazsa Aylin deniz kenarında kamp yapmak istiyor.

tr.note: Etkinlik bildiren '-ing' sözcükleriyle 'go' arasına 'to' girmez: go camping, go swimming, go fishing.

mistakes.wrong: We went to camping last summer.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki 'kampa gitmek' yönelme eki yüzünden 'to' eklenir. 'Go' + '-ing' kalıbında 'to' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: We took a tent and sleeping bags because we wanted to ______.

def.short: high land that is lower and rounder than a mountain
def.long: An area of high land that is lower than a mountain. Many towns are built on hills, and people like to walk up them for the view.

examples.en: We climbed the hill to watch the sunset.
examples.tr: Gün batımını izlemek için tepeye tırmandık.

examples.en: The village is on a green hill near the sea.
examples.tr: Köy, denize yakın yeşil bir tepenin üzerinde.

examples.en: Riding a bike up the hill was hard, but going down was fun.
examples.tr: Bisikletle yokuşu çıkmak zordu ama inmek eğlenceliydi.

etymology.text: From Old English 'hyll'. It is related to Latin 'collis', meaning hill.

tr.note: Yol için 'hill' yokuş anlamına da gelir: 'walk up the hill' (yokuşu çıkmak).

quiz.cloze: The house is high up on a ______, so it has a great view of the town.

def.short: a large area of fresh water with land all around it
def.long: A large area of water with land all around it. The water is usually not salty, and people swim, fish or sail on it.

examples.en: We swam in the lake every morning.
examples.tr: Her sabah gölde yüzdük.

examples.en: There is a small lake behind the village.
examples.tr: Köyün arkasında küçük bir göl var.

examples.en: In winter the lake freezes, and children skate on the ice.
examples.tr: Kışın göl donar ve çocuklar buzun üstünde paten kayar.

etymology.text: From Latin 'lacus', meaning a pond or a pool, through Old French 'lac'.

mistakes.wrong: We visited Van Lake last summer.
mistakes.right: We visited Lake Van last summer.
mistakes.why: Türkçede göl adı önce gelir (Van Gölü). İngilizcede göl adlarında genellikle 'Lake' önce gelir: Lake Van, Lake Tuz.

quiz.cloze: On hot days we swim in the ______ near our village.

def.short: a large area of land covered with many trees
def.long: A large area of land covered with trees and plants, where many wild animals live. A forest is bigger and wilder than a wood or a park.

examples.en: There are many tall trees in this forest.
examples.tr: Bu ormanda bir sürü uzun ağaç var.

examples.en: Elena saw a deer in the forest this morning.
examples.tr: Elena bu sabah ormanda bir geyik gördü.

examples.en: Don't light a fire in the forest when the weather is hot and dry.
examples.tr: Hava sıcak ve kuruyken ormanda ateş yakmayın.

etymology.text: From Old French 'forest' and Medieval Latin 'forestis'. It probably comes from Latin 'foris', meaning outside.

tr.note: Daha küçük ormanlık alana 'wood' ya da 'the woods' denir.

quiz.cloze: Many wild animals live in the ______, among the tall trees.

def.micro: what you see from a place
def.short: everything you can see from a place, especially beautiful land, sea or sky
def.long: Everything you can see from a certain place, especially land, sea or a city that is nice to look at. Hotels often have rooms with a sea view.

examples.en: The view from the hill is amazing.
examples.tr: Tepeden görünen manzara harika.

examples.en: Our hotel room had a view of the sea.
examples.tr: Otel odamız deniz manzaralıydı.

examples.en: We stopped the car on the mountain road to enjoy the view.
examples.tr: Manzaranın tadını çıkarmak için dağ yolunda arabayı durdurduk.

etymology.text: From Old French 'veue', meaning sight, from 'veoir', to see, which comes from Latin 'videre'.

tr.note: 'View' görüş, fikir anlamına da gelir: 'In my view…' (bence). Bu kartta manzara anlamı var.

quiz.cloze: Let's sit by the window. The ______ of the mountains is beautiful from here.
